newsitem.title: UK: Debt strategists say buy Russia, sell Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Debt strategists say buy Russia, sell Brazil.

text.p: Russian debt was trading cheap relative to Brazilian Bradys and analysts on Wednesday recommended investors switch between the two.
WestMerchant Capital Markets suggested buying Russian IANs and selling Brazil DCBs, whilst Bank of America said Russian PRINs should be bought versus Brazil C bonds.
"The accumulation of positive events in Russian have only marginally been reflected in prices," WestMerchant Capital Markets research said.
The IMF and World Bank have endorsed Russia's current policy stance and agreed to bridge budget shortfalls.
Recent data suggest economic growth and statements out of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development indicate that the Vnesheconombank debt restructuring deal may be closed by August.
Both WestMerchant and Bank of America believe Russian debt prices have under-performed and have not moved significanly, as yet, on this news.
The Russian IAN trades at 223 basis points above Brazil DCB compared to 100 b.p. at the start of the year but is expected to tighten by 50 b.p., WestMerchant said.

The Bank of America research recommended Russia PRINs against Brazil Cs on the strength of PRINs still offering deal premium and the highest spread against the Russian curve. It also said Russia has less linkage to U.S. monetary policy.
